text:
rachel: Quick heads-up planning a tfstate consolidation during the release window tomorrow 04:00-05:30 UTC. We'll merge tenant-vpc -> tenant-vpc-core and move edge-egress into network-global. Holding merges that touch backends/providers until staging plan signoff.

omar: Ack. I'll run the staging plan and post artifacts. Are we doing a provider pin for the window?

rachel: Yes, pin to hashicorp/aws = 4.12.2 for the window only. Branch will include required_providers in modules that touch S3/Dynamo.

sydney: Rollback conditions? Propose abort if plan shows any route deletions, more than 4 IAM changes, or >2 provider version diffs. If triggered we'll restore tfstate snapshot and re-lock.

omar: I'll snapshot states to s3://tfstate-backups/release-1753309999/ and upload `staging.plan` + `staging.plan.txt`. CI run will use `-backend-config=staging.hcl`.

rachel: Add these to release notes: steps to restore, DynamoDB lock check, `terraform show` artifact location, and the manual deploybot approval. Plan upload path: s3://tf-plans/release-1753309999/staging.plan.

deploybot: deploybot: apply queued and blocked by merge-hold "tfstate-consol-qa". To proceed, comment `@deploybot approve tfstate-consol-qa` on this thread. Scheduled apply timer: 1753318000.

oncall-bot: Preflight scheduled at 03:30 UTC: state-snapshot, lock-verify, plan-diff. Failure will post alert here and ping infra oncall.

omar: I'll run a `terraform state list | wc -l` pre/post snapshot check and include counts in the artifacts. Also will run `./scripts/check-lock.sh --table tf-locks-prod`.

sydney: I'll monitor prod:metrics/network and prod:metrics/iam during the window. If anything anomalous, I'll execute restore steps and escalate.

rachel: Locking merge-hold now. Please keep comments short and prefix ops-runbook lines with `#ops` so I can copy them straight into the release notes.

deploybot: deploybot: merge-hold locked by rachel. To proceed after validation, tag `@deploybot approve tfstate-consol-qa`.

omar: Plan uploaded: s3://tf-plans/release-1753309999/staging.plan (staging.plan.txt attached). Target final decision at 23:50 UTC tonight.

sydney: Reviewed plan diff  no deletions, IAM churn within threshold. +1 to proceed to serial apply (tenant-vpc-core then network-global) with 20m telemetry between.

rachel: Thanks all. Will remove hold after one more signoff from ops and then @deploybot will run the serial applies.
